statProperties.name: Ailment Chance
statProperties.altText: For skills which have less chance to apply ailments on hit, nodes within that skill's tree always grant the stated amount, unaffected by that less chance modifier.

statProperties.name: Attack Speed
statProperties.altText: Increases the number of attacks you can use per second

statProperties.name: Cast Speed
statProperties.altText: Increases the number of spells you can cast per second

statProperties.name: Critical Strike Chance
statProperties.altText: Increases your chance to deal a critical strike. Your base crit chance is 5% so 100% increased crit chance would give you 10% crit chance if there are no other modifiers.

statProperties.name: Critical Strike Multiplier
statProperties.altText: Increases the damage dealt by your critical strikes

statProperties.name: Damage Taken
statProperties.altText: Modifies the damage you take

statProperties.name: Health
statProperties.altText: Increases your maximum health

statProperties.name: Mana
statProperties.altText: Increases your maximum mana

statProperties.name: Movement Speed
statProperties.altText: Increases how quickly you can run

statProperties.name: Armor
statProperties.altText: Armor reduces the damage you take from all hits, but not damage over time. More effective against physical damage.

statProperties.name: Dodge Rating
statProperties.altText: Improves your chance to dodge

statProperties.name: Stun Avoidance
statProperties.altText: All hits can have a chance to stun you based on their damage. Stun Avoidance reduces that chance.

statProperties.name: Fire Resistance
statProperties.altText: Reduces all fire damage you take. Capped at 75%.

statProperties.name: Cold Resistance
statProperties.altText: Reduces all cold damage you take. Capped at 75%.

statProperties.name: Lightning Resistance
statProperties.altText: Reduces all lightning damage you take. Capped at 75%.

statProperties.name: Ward Retention
statProperties.altText: Ward is decaying shield with no limit, that steadily decays. Ward retention reduces the rate at which your ward decays.

statProperties.name: Health Regen
statProperties.altText: Increases the rate at which your health regenerates over time

statProperties.name: Mana Regen
statProperties.altText: Increases the rate at which your mana regenerates over time

statProperties.name: Strength
statProperties.altText: Each point of strength increases armor by 4% and improves skills that rely the raw strength of you and your companions

statProperties.name: Vitality
statProperties.altText: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.

statProperties.name: Intelligence
statProperties.altText: Each point of intelligence grants 2% ward retention and improves skills that rely on carefully studied magic

statProperties.name: Dexterity
statProperties.altText: Each point of dexterity adds 4 dodge rating and improves skills that rely on the skillful handling of weapons

statProperties.name: Attunement
statProperties.altText: Each point of attunement grants 2 mana and improves skills that rely on the innate magic inside you and your surroundings

statProperties.name: Damage Dealt to Mana Before Health
statProperties.altText: A percentage of the damage you take is dealt to your mana instead of your health. Each point of mana shields 5 health.

statProperties.name: Channel Cost
statProperties.altText: Modifies the mana cost per second of channelled skills

statProperties.name: Void Resistance
statProperties.altText: Reduces all void damage you take. Capped at 75%.

statProperties.name: Necrotic Resistance
statProperties.altText: Reduces all necrotic damage you take. Capped at 75%.

statProperties.name: Poison Resistance
statProperties.altText: Reduces all poison damage you take. Capped at 75%.

statProperties.name: Block Chance
statProperties.altText: Adds to your chance to block. Blocked hits deal less damage depending on your block effectiveness.

statProperties.name: All Resistances
statProperties.altText: Adds to your physical, fire, cold, lightning, necrotic, void, and poison resistances.

statProperties.name: Health Gain
statProperties.altText: Instantly regain health

statProperties.name: Ward Gain
statProperties.altText: Instantly gain ward. Ward is a temporary shield that decays over time based on the amount you currently have.

statProperties.name: Mana Gain
statProperties.altText: Instantly regain mana

statProperties.name: Adaptive Spell Damage
statProperties.altText: Adds damage to all spells. The type of damage added matches the base damage of the spell.

statProperties.name: Increased Ailment Duration
statProperties.altText: Increases the duration of ailments you inflict

statProperties.name: Increased Ailment Effect
statProperties.altText: Increases the effect of ailments you inflict

statProperties.name: Increased Healing Effectiveness
statProperties.altText: Increases the health restored by healing skills

statProperties.name: Increased Stun Chance
statProperties.altText: All your hits have a chance to stun if they deal enough damage. Increased stun chance increases that chance.

statProperties.name: All Attributes
statProperties.altText: Adds to your Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Attunement, and Vitality.

statProperties.name: Increased Chance To Find Potions
statProperties.altText: Increases your chance to find potions. Potions are displayed next to your health globe, and can be consumed to gain health (by using the 1 key by default).

statProperties.name: Health Gained on Potion Use
statProperties.altText: Potions are displayed next to your health globe, and can be consumed to gain health (by using the 1 key by default).

statProperties.name: Potion Slots
statProperties.altText: Adds to your maximum number of potions. Potions are displayed next to your health globe, and can be consumed to gain health (by using the 1 key by default).

statProperties.name: Damage Leeched as Health
statProperties.altText: A percentage of your damage is returned to you as health over three seconds.

statProperties.name: Elemental Resistance
statProperties.altText: Adds to your fire, cold, and lightning resistances.

statProperties.name: Block Effectiveness
statProperties.altText: Block Effectiveness reduces damage taken for hits you block.

statProperties.name: Increased Stun Immunity Duration
statProperties.altText: By default when you are stunned you become immune to stuns for one second after the stun ends. This increases the duration of that immunity.

statProperties.name: Stun Immunity
statProperties.altText: Prevents you from being stunned

statProperties.name: Dark Protection (deprecated)
statProperties.altText: Protects against void, poison, and necrotic damage. 10 dark protection is like 10 effective health against void, poison, or necrotic damage.

statProperties.name: Penetration
statProperties.altText: Penetration can reduce effective resistance below 0%, increasing damage even against enemies with no resistance. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

statProperties.name: Chance to receive a Glancing Blow when hit
statProperties.altText: Grants a chance to recieve a glancing blow when hit. Glancing blows deal 35% less damage.

statProperties.name: Mana Cost
statProperties.altText: Modifies the cost of skills you use

statProperties.name: Freeze Rate Multiplier
statProperties.altText: Cold skills have a chance to freeze on hit equal to their freeze rate divided by the target's health.

statProperties.name: Mana Efficiency
statProperties.altText:
Increases the efficiency of your mana usage
Mana cost = base mana cost / (1 + mana efficiency)

statProperties.name: Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed
statProperties.altText: Increases the speed at which your skills come off cooldown

statProperties.name: Physical Resistance
statProperties.altText: Reduces all physical damage you take. Capped at 75%.

statProperties.name: Current Health Drained per Second
statProperties.altText: Drains a percent of your current health per second. You can't die from this effect

statProperties.name: Cull on Hit
statProperties.altText: Enemies are killed at this percentage of their health

statProperties.name: Damage Taken as Lightning
statProperties.altText: Damage converted to lightning before mitigation

statProperties.name: Damage Taken as Physical
statProperties.altText: Damage converted to physical before mitigation

statProperties.name: Damage Taken as Fire
statProperties.altText: Damage converted to fire before mitigation

statProperties.name: Damage Taken as Cold
statProperties.altText: Damage converted to cold before mitigation

statProperties.name: Damage Taken as Void
statProperties.altText: Damage converted to void before mitigation

statProperties.name: Damage Taken as Poison
statProperties.altText: Damage converted to poison before mitigation

statProperties.name: Damage Taken as Necrotic
statProperties.altText: Damage converted to necrotic before mitigation

statProperties.name: Maximum Companions
statProperties.altText: Increases the maximum number of companions a Primalist can have active at once

statProperties.name: Chance to gain Haste for 1 second on Hit
statProperties.altText: Haste is a buff that grants 30% increased movement speed. Haste does not stack.

statProperties.name: Chance to Chill Attackers
statProperties.altText: Gives you a chance to chill enemies when they hit you. Chill reduces attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed by 12% (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts 4 seconds. It can stack up to 3 times and is 50% less effective against Players.

statProperties.name: Chance to Slow Attackers
statProperties.altText: Gives you a chance to slow enemies when they hit you. Each stack of Slow reduces movement speed by 20% (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts 4 seconds. It can stacks up to 3 times and is 50% less effective against Players.

statProperties.name: Damage Reflected to Attackers
statProperties.altText: Damage is dealt directly to attackers when you take a hit. Not affected by enemy defenses.

statProperties.name: Damage Reflected
statProperties.altText: A percentage of the damage you take is dealt directly to the attacker. Mitigation applies before reflection. Reflecting damage does not affect how much damage you take.

statProperties.name: Chance to Shock Attackers
statProperties.altText: Gives you a chance to shock enemies when they hit you. Shock reduces lightning resistance by 5%, increases chance to be stunned by 20%, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack up to 10 times. It has 60% reduced effect against bosses and players.

statProperties.name: Critical Strike Avoidance
statProperties.altText: Gives a chance to downgrade an enemy's crit on you to a regular hit. Unmodified enemies have a 5% crit chance.

statProperties.name: Potion Health Converted to Ward
statProperties.altText: A percentage of the health you would gain from using a potion is gained as ward instead. There is no effect above 100%.

statProperties.name: Ward Gained on Potion Use
statProperties.altText: Ward is a decaying shield that protects your health

statProperties.name: Overkill Damage Leeched as Health
statProperties.altText: When you kill an enemy with a hit a percentage of the excess damage is returned to you as health over three seconds.

statProperties.name: Ward per Second
statProperties.altText: Causes you to generate ward over time. Ward naturally decays over time so your total ward will stabilize at a point where the regen is equal to the decay.

statProperties.name: Damage Dealt to Mana Before Health or Ward
statProperties.altText: A percentage of the damage you take is dealt to your mana instead of your health or ward. Each point of mana shields 5 health.

statProperties.name: Increased Stun Duration
statProperties.altText: Increases the duration of stuns you inflict

statProperties.name: Duration of Stuns Received
statProperties.altText: Reduces the duration of stuns on you

statProperties.name: Chance to Gain 30 Ward when Hit
statProperties.altText: Ward is a decaying overshield that protect your health. Extra chance above 100% has no effect. Applies after damage taken, unless the damage would be lethal.

statProperties.name: Mana Spent Gained as Ward
statProperties.altText: Ward is a decaying overshield that protect your health. Only affects mana spent, not mana drained.

statProperties.name: Increased Leech Rate
statProperties.altText: Increases the speed at which health is gained from Health Leech. Does not change the total amount leeched.

statProperties.name: Freeze Rate per stack of Chill
statProperties.altText: Increases your chance to freeze for each stack of chill on the target. Multiplicative with other modifiers.

statProperties.name: Physical and Void Resistance
statProperties.altText: Adds to your physical and void resistances.

statProperties.name: Necrotic and Poison Resistance
statProperties.altText: Adds to your necrotic and poison resistances.

statProperties.name: Chance to Receive a Critical Strike
statProperties.altText: Adds to your chance to receive a critical strike when hit. Not affected by the attacker's increased critical strike chance.

statProperties.name: Endurance
statProperties.altText: Endurance reduces damage dealt to your health below your Endurance Threshold. Capped at 60%.

statProperties.name: Endurance Threshold
statProperties.altText: Damage dealt to your health below your Endurance Threshold is reduced by your Endurance

statProperties.name: Maximum Health gained as Endurance Threshold
statProperties.altText: Gain a portion of your maximum health as endurance threshold. Damage taken your health below your endurance threshold is reduced by your endurance.

statProperties.name: reduced Bonus Damage Taken from Critical Strikes
statProperties.altText: Reduces the bonus damage taken from crits. Cannot reduce damage below that of a regular hit. This stat is multiplicative with other damage modifiers, but multiple sources of this stat are additive.

statProperties.name: More Damage Per Stack
statProperties.altText: Counts stacks on the Target. Multiplicative with other modifiers.

statProperties.name: increased Area for Area Skills
statProperties.altText: Increases the area of effect of skills with the Area tag. Additive with other sources of increased area.

statProperties.name: Global Conditional Damage
statProperties.altText: Multiplicative with other modifiers

statProperties.name: Armor Mitigation also applies to Damage over Time
statProperties.altText: For example, if you have enough armor to reduce hit damage by 60% and 50% of your Armor Mitigation also applies to Damage over Time then armor will reduce damage over time by 30%.

statProperties.name: Ward Decay Threshold
statProperties.altText: Ward does not decay below your Ward Decay Threshold and ward below the threshold does not contribute to decay rate. For example if you have a Ward Decay Threshold of 500 then ward will not decay below 500 and ward decay rate at 1000 ward will be halved.

statProperties.name: Parry Chance
statProperties.altText: Parrying a hit reduces the hit damage taken to zero. It does not prevent other effects of the hit. Parry Chance has no effect on damage over time and is capped at 75%. Parried hits cannot also be blocked and cannot be glancing blows.

statProperties.name: Lens
statProperties.altText:
Increases your chance to see certain prophecies in the observatory.

Lenses that block activities or increase the cost of prophecies do not stack.

statProperties.name: Chance to Cast When Hit
statProperties.altText: If the ability has a cooldown, it must be on your bar and off cooldown, and this effect puts it on cooldown.

statProperties.name: Global Conditional Critical Strike Chance
statProperties.altText: Multiplicative with other modifiers
